message:
4 positional locator read(s) taken in the window an action opened, with no auto-retrying assertion between:
      card.spec.ts:28 — reads a positional locator written into the read itself in the window the action at line 27 opened: expect( await rimOf<' '>(page.locator(' ').first(), ' '), ).toBe(' ')
      card.spec.ts:36 — reads a positional locator written into the read itself in the window the action at line 35 opened: expect( await widthOf<' '>(page.locator(' ').nth(1), ' '), ).toBe(' ')
      card.spec.ts:44 — reads a positional locator written into the read itself in the window the action at line 43 opened: expect( await page .locator(' ') .last() .evaluate<string>((el) => getComputedStyle(el).bord
      card.spec.ts:55 — reads a positional locator written into the read itself in the window the action at line 54 opened: expect( await pick<Record<string, string>>(page.locator(' ').nth(2), {}), ).toBe(' ')
    A
why: Four hovered or focused cards, each read with type arguments between the name and its call: `rimOf<'border-color'>(…)`, an arrow with type parameters; `pick<Record<string, string>>(…)`, whose type parameter and argument hold one of their own; `widthOf<'border-width'>(…)`, a function declaration with them; and Playwright's `evaluate<string>(…)`. A name followed by `<…>` and not by its `(` is no call to a pattern that wants the parenthesis next, so each read goes by unreported, and so does a definition whose parameters come after its type parameters.
